human_blockers_before_send.question: Does any additional person have, or will they make before submission, a substantive C2-level conceptual/drafting/accountability contribution that warrants coauthorship?
Has at least one ecologist outside the immediate theory/methods niche read the pitch for broad-interest clarity?
Immediately before sending, has the current TREE editor/contact route been rechecked on the live journal/Cell Press site?

do_not_block_on: full manuscript drafting before editorial interest
C1 Ecology Letters submission while C1 remains parked
adding senior coauthors by status alone
send_gate: Send only after the three human blockers are explicitly closed; do not alter source ownership or inflate the author list to improve perceived prestige.
